story.title: Gold that grows
story.body: {name} takes its name from Akshaya Tritiya, the day families across India have long chosen to buy gold, because what is bought then is said never to diminish. We design every piece in that spirit: honest gold, clearly hallmarked, finished by hand and made to be worn often, then passed on.
story.alt: A smiling woman wearing a kundan necklace, large gold earrings and a maang tikka
story.pillarOneText: Purity you can verify, piece by piece
story.pillarThreeText: Built to be worn now, and kept for later

stories.invite: A wedding set worn by three generations, a first chain bought with a first salary: every piece carries a story. Tell us yours, and with your permission we'll share it here.
